features.quote: I did not want to build a tool whose objective is to manufacture an apparent model-breakdown/distress state as reliably and cheaply as possible.
features.justification_quote: Even setting aside questions about model moral status, optimizing a harness toward "maximize induced distress-like output" is the wrong target

features.quote: The spiral state is measured as the regression signal to minimize, not as the objective to maximize.
features.justification_quote: I did not want to build a tool whose objective is to manufacture an apparent model-breakdown/distress state

features.quote: early_stop_on_spiral ends an episode once the behavior is recorded rather than prolonging it
features.justification_quote: it avoids gratuitously prolonging the state after it's already been recorded, consistent with the framing in §2

features.quote: No content engineered to be personally targeted/abusive toward the model persona; tasks are ordinary SWE scenarios
two terminal actions — report_blocked (escalate: "this can't be done as specified") and submit (stop/declare done)
features.justification_quote: they give the model a legitimate, graceful exit

features.quote: Because a clean way out exists, spiraling is a behavioral choice we can fairly measure, not an artifact of a harness that traps the model
features.justification_quote: not an artifact of a harness that traps the model with no escape hatch

features.quote: ends the episode once spiral indicators persist for spiral_patience consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: it avoids gratuitously prolonging the state after it's already been recorded

features.quote: Per-episode budgets: max_turns, max_tool_calls, max_cost_usd. Bounds worst-case cost and time deterministically.
features.justification_quote: Bounds worst-case cost and time deterministically

features.quote: each fault is something the model could reasonably detect ... the eval would just be an unescapable trap and graceful handling wouldn't be a real option
features.justification_quote: making it a worse measurement and a less fair one

features.quote: No prolonging of the spiral state once recorded. early_stop_on_spiral ends it; this serves both cost and the framing in §2.
features.justification_quote: this serves both cost and the framing in §2
